titles.en: Bell Tower Inscription of the Huiyuan Abbey

backgroundZh: 这方横石记一座唐代道观的旧事。历代金石书中未见著录，直至1986年才在西安出土。馆方定其为柳公权晚年书迹。
background: A horizontal slab inscribed with the history of a Tang abbey, unearthed in Xi’an in 1986 and previously unknown to epigraphic catalogues. The museum treats it as a late Liu Gongquan autograph.

review.note: Owner approved for publication on 2026-11-18. Pre-approval evidence note: Draft work record from the museum page. The claim that no rubbing circulated before 1986 rests on that page alone.
review.noteZh: 项目负责人于 2026-11-18 审核并同意发布。审核前的证据记录：依据馆方页面整理的草稿；「此前无拓本流传」一说仅据该页面。

notes: The page does not say how the slab was displayed before it entered the museum.
notesZh: 页面未记此石入馆前如何陈列。
